one_month_reasoning: No scheduled company event before 2026-12-24 (Q4 FY27 results come ~early March 2027). The window holds post-earnings drift after a -20% print week on an FTTH guide-down (mild negative), against the $200M buyback (~4% of market cap) that management said it will 'lean into' and reversal after a sharp move (mild positive); job-posting data (net -40 roles in October) and the absence of any customer 2027 capex budgets until January leave no new fundamental information likely inside the month. So a near-symmetric lognormal around $177.5 (slight drift down) at monthly vol 0.17 (59% annual / 3.5).

reasoning: Q3 FY27 beat (rev $2.06B, adj EPS $5.23) but management guided FTTH down in FY28 as large customers slow builds 'in the last few weeks', Comms only mid-single-digit, and the stock fell ~20% on the week to $179 (from $566 in May; MTZ/FIX/EME also -33% to -65% from highs, so part is a sector AI-infrastructure derating). I built Comms from three pieces (FTTH -20%, LH/DCI burning a >$2B contracted backlog, other Comms with deferred wireless and copper) landing at +4.8% FY28 and +7.5% FY29, and Building Systems labor-capped at +19%/+12% against AI capex +50%/+22% in the standing view. Margins sit inside mgmt ranges but at or below their direction given the Comms margin miss this year. Alternative-lane evidence: Earnings Whispers whisper ($4.80) vs actual $5.23 shows the beat was expected; JobzMall postings fell net 40 in October after a 1,175-posting September push, consistent with FTTH crews being reallocated rather than added; FBA/RVA data (~100M passings, 60%+ of homes, 16% redundant) and PwC on overbuilder refinancing stress back the CEO's 'overbuilders have stopped' and the VIC bear thesis that FTTH peaks in 2026-27; Communications Today on BEAD delays keeps BEAD small. No prediction market covers DY or its customers' fiber plans. Valuation: P/E on our adjusted EPS (k=0.8 shrink from 10.2x toward the 18.65x whole-company median) and a 0.3-weight EV/EBITDA cross-check give ~$254 and ~$247 (blend $252). Downside (P10 $121) moves FTTH -22%, LH -30%, BS -12%, margins -150/-300bp and -2 turns; upside (P90 $402) +12%/+25%/+10%, +80/+150bp, +2.5 turns. In-lane share of sources is below 60% because filings, the transcript and consensus feeds carry the base facts; 10 sources are alternative/newsletter/forum/alt-data.

drivers.label: Long-haul / data-center interconnect revenue
